caption: Broccoli corn fingers 🤍 Easy lunch for babies & toddlers. Ingredients: • 1 small head broccoli (steamed) • 2 eggs • 2 tbsp corn (skip for younger babies) • Handful shredded cheese Directions: Mash broccoli → mix everything → top with cheese → bake at 180°C / 350°F for 20–25 min Cut into finger pieces and serve 💛 Perfect for BLW and toddlers.
